title: Iran's Industrial Revolution:
text:
Iran's Industrial Revolution:"

" Iran’s Defense Ministry Spokesman Announces Doubling of Arms Production, Halt on Weapons Unveilings to Surprise Enemies"

"Summary:"
"In a late-night TV interview on August 21, Iranian Defense Ministry spokesman General Reza Talaei-Nik stated that national power is the key strategy for preserving Iran's independence and security. He said Iran's defense production has doubled over the past year (July 2025–July 2026) following the "12-day war," with some strategic items seeing a threefold increase during active conflict. He emphasized synchronization of production with battlefield consumption, and announced that Iran has stopped monthly public unveilings of new weapons to protect operational secrecy. Talaei-Nik also claimed Iran ranks among the world's top ten countries in missile technology and among the top nations in drone production, with over 1,000 advanced indigenous systems now being manufactured domestically. He dismissed recent threats from Trump and Netanyahu, framing Iran's military growth as a response to "hybrid" threats combining military and non-military fronts."
